long_description:
Yoga with a Creature Feature

Sunday, October 25 

Sunday, November 15

Sunday, December 20

10-11:30 a.m.

Join us for a morning of Michigan wildlife and yoga! We'll start our program by featuring one of our wildlife ambassadors with a short presentation and Q&A. Then we'll roll our mats into the "outdoors" here in the Outdoor Adventure Center for a mindful yoga practice with yoga instructor Mollie Flores. A limited number of yoga mats are available for loan. This is a beginner-friendly class. The OAC will open to the general public at noon – free to explore the exhibits afterwards!

Featured wildlife amabassadors:

October 25: gray rat snake

November 15: lake sturgeon

December 20: Blanding’s turtle

Participants must be ages 12 or older.

Preregistration is required. Cost is $10 per person.

Click the "Tickets" link to register.
